    pid_l = tl.program_id(0)
    row = tl.program_id(1)
    d = row % D
    offs = pid_l * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    mask = offs < L
    base = row * L

    w0 = tl.load(w_ptr + d * 4 + 0).to(tl.float32)
    w1 = tl.load(w_ptr + d * 4 + 1).to(tl.float32)
    w2 = tl.load(w_ptr + d * 4 + 2).to(tl.float32)
    w3 = tl.load(w_ptr + d * 4 + 3).to(tl.float32)

    x0 = tl.load(x_ptr + base + offs - 3, mask=mask & (offs >= 3), other=0.0).to(tl.float32)

    x2 = tl.load(x_ptr + base + offs - 1, mask=mask & (offs >= 1), other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
    x3 = tl.load(x_ptr + base + offs,     mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
